steps.name: recording-frame-timestamps
steps.subject: Video recording: each frame stamped with the recording clock
steps.description:
Frames were stamped from a frame counter and one QVideoFrame was re-sent with changed times, so
dropped frames sped the video up and frames already queued in QMediaRecorder had their times
changed (the TODO upstream notes "severe frame corruption"). Each submitted frame is now its own copy
stamped with the elapsed recording time.
